integrity: The universal result has a complete combinatorial proof; finite exhaustive checking is limited to n=3..9 and n=3..7 by two independent programs; no external independent validation has occurred.
limitations: The claimed exchange graph concerns F(C_n square K_2) for integers n>=3, with any single alternating cycle allowed. No fixed-small-cycle or arbitrary-cubic-graph extension is proved. Equivalent statements outside the inspected sources may exist.
title: The diameter-two single-cycle flip graph of perfect matchings in Fisher-transformed prisms
